column1: # Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream on Android (keys in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "Game profiles on Android")
# Nintendo's engine on SDK 20.5.3, update 1.0.4; 14,400 shaders, all translated.
# Tested 2026-11-06 on the Legion Y700 (TB322FC, Snapdragon 8 Elite, Adreno 830, Android 16), docked: the date check, region and currency, the island (the 3D island, its sea and
# trees, the cursor and the camera), naming the island, the Mii creation menus, the guided Mii creation (face questions, the 3D Mii with its face, height and body type).
# 60 fps (frame work p50 about 5 ms), 0 dropped frames, 0 audio underruns, no red log line.
# It aborted at boot until the host answered ClockSnapshot::CreateWithAdjustableSystemClock (hle_time.c).
# The Mii heads and their faces (eyes, eyebrows, nose, mouth) were empty until render_cond (game.tsv): the Mii renderer draws a depth pre-pass, then clears depth under a
# render condition and draws the colour pass with depth test EQUAL; the clear ran unconditionally and every head draw failed the test. The game uses no MiiModel system data.
